dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped rings and two 'C' shaped structures display sharp light-to-dark gradient transitions, with irregular, serrated outer perimeters and darker internal centers localized in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low-density distribution of solid white punctate clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated along the transition boundary between the patterned lateral region and the solid-colored ventral area.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli form a non-equilateral quadrilateral with internal angles approximately at 70, 110, 85, and 95 degrees, situated along the mid-longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Abrupt termination of the reticulated pattern at the cervical-cephalic junction, transitioning into a solid, high-density dark pigment region across the entire head.
